trailhead.label: Top station of the Taser cable car at the Taser Alm, the board’s start

cautions: The last hour to Tall is on a tarred access road open to cars: lead on and keep to the side.
Cattle may graze around the Taser and Streitweider alms in summer: keep your dog on a short lead and give cows a wide berth.
A few short, steeper stretches of mountain path on the Höhenweg.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
